sources.snippet: This project implements a Named Entity Recognition (NER) system using the RoBERTa-base model fine-tuned on the CoNLL-2003 dataset. The model identifies and classifies named entities in text into four categories: PERSON, ORGANIZATION, LOCATION, and MISC.
